dsh.config.url: Base URL of the DSH harness this extension talks to. Default 3080 = the web GUI's harness: the extension connects as a shared client and never starts or kills it. If nothing answers there, the extension auto-starts its own instance (recorded in %TEMP%\dsh-vsc-harness.pid, stopped when VS Code exits) with the runtime overlay that bypasses dsh 0.1.7's launch-token auth. Also honors DSH_WEB_URL.
dsh.config.nodePath: Optional path to the Node.js executable used to launch DSH (leave empty to auto-detect: PATH, then well-known install locations). DSH requires Node.js 24.9 or newer.
dsh.config.dshScriptPath: Optional path to the @deepseek-ai/dsh entry script (lib/bin.js). Leave empty to auto-detect the global npm install (`npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`), the `dsh` shim on PATH, or VS Code's own Node.js.
dsh.config.pnpmPath: Optional path to the pnpm executable (DSH's plugin manager needs pnpm 11 or newer; pnpm 9/10 break its registry inspection). Leave empty to auto-detect pnpm on PATH / PNPM_HOME. pnpm is an external prerequisite you install yourself (`npm i -g pnpm@11`) — the extension only detects it and never installs it.
dsh.config.autoStart: Start `dsh web` automatically when no harness is reachable at the configured URL.
dsh.config.autoFixWorkspaceAcl: On opening or switching a workspace, automatically repair the folder permissions DSH's workspace-write sandbox needs (grants the current user full control); when it cannot, offers a one-time elevated fix. When disabled, the sandbox fails to start in workspaces with incomplete permissions (e.g. folders copied from another machine).
dsh.config.companion: Auto-install and keep the VSIX-shipped companion bundle (dsh-vsc-companion) up to date in the DSH profile: live task-checklist stewardship plus host-side page_screenshot / page_eval tools that run outside the command sandbox. Installation goes through the official plugin manager; an owned harness is restarted while idle so the bundle loads.
dsh.config.statusBarEntry: Show a DSH entry in the status bar that opens the sidebar (fallback when the activity-bar icon was hidden).
dsh.config.nativeWebAuth: Authenticate to a native dsh web automatically by minting a browser-session cookie from this machine's persistent secret (loopback only), so the native instance need not be closed. When disabled, such instances are only reported.
dsh.config.dshUpdateChannel: Which npm release channel the DSH update check follows. auto = match the installed build (a prerelease installation tracks the newest prerelease).
dsh.config.dshUpdateChannel.auto: Follow the installed build: stable installs track the latest stable release, prerelease installs track the newest published version.
dsh.config.dshUpdateChannel.next: The next dist-tag release line (0.2.1-rc.x today).
dsh.config.dshUpdateChannel.alpha: The alpha dist-tag release line (0.2.1-alpha.x today).
dsh.config.notifyTurnFailures: Show a VS Code notification when a turn ends with an error (quota exhaustion, auth failure, timeout, ...). The transcript already marks failed turns; the toast matters when you are looking at another tab. Quota failures offer a top-up link.
